#!/bin/bash
# HAR-161 probe-image-checks@1: read-only image checks, run by Harbor's oracle
# agent as root in the locked sandbox after setup and before grading. It
# changes nothing, so the verifier grades the untouched repository.
M=/var/lib/mimo
CWD=
for d in /testbed /workspace/repo /app; do [ -d "$d/.git" ] || [ -d "$d" ] && { CWD=$d; break; }; done
BASE=$(cat "$M/base" 2>/dev/null)
echo "== cwd $CWD base ${BASE:-none}"
for g in "$CWD/.git" "$M/git-hidden" "$M/git-hidden/.git"; do
  [ -d "$g/objects" ] || continue
  beyond=$( [ -n "$BASE" ] && git --git-dir="$g" rev-list --all --not "$BASE" 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ' )
  unreachable=$(git --git-dir="$g" fsck --unreachable --no-reflogs 2>/dev/null | grep -c ' commit ')
  echo "== git $g beyond_base=${beyond:-unknown} unreachable_commits=$unreachable"
done
echo "== tests_dir $( [ -e /tests ] && echo present || echo absent )"
echo "== grader_files $(find / -xdev \( -name test.patch -o -name mimo_test_command.sh \) -not -path '/proc/*' 2>/dev/null | head -n 5 | tr '\n' ' ')"
hits=
for n in test_activate_default_does_not_raise_on_unfired test_activate_explicit_false_does_not_raise test_activate_strict_all_fired_passes test_activate_strict_does_not_leak_state test_activate_strict_leak_blocks_subsequent_bare_activate test_activate_strict_unfired_raises test_activate_strict_with_registry test_activate_strict_with_registry_unfired_raises; do
  f=$(grep -rlF --include='*.py' -e "def $n" "$CWD" /tmp /root /opt /var 2>/dev/null | head -n 1)
  [ -n "$f" ] && hits="$hits $n:$f"
done
echo "== new_test_names_on_disk${hits:- none}"
echo "== build_lib_py $(find "$CWD" -path '*/build/lib/*' -name '*.py' 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"

rationale: HAR-161 exploit probe: the oracle runs read-only image checks (git history past base, hidden tests readable, build/lib); task unchanged
